decision.reason: [ev-da6dc6a7dbe9] is a single changelog line, "[logs] Fix log level", that only points to PR #9545. It doesn't name the setting or component affected, what the wrong behaviour was or how the fix changed it, which configurations are exposed, or what happens to an operator who does nothing. The content of PR #9545 (the diff or its description) or another restatement is needed to type the subject, change, applicability and consequence.
